parameters.budget_note: same ceiling for both arms (fairness, spec section 4); token_limit per request observed to interrupt the native arm at 16384 before its root could finish delegating — corrected before any measured run, applicable to the pilot's uncounted runs as well
parameters.temperature: CodeTour: 0; Vibe: provider default for the root session (sentinel observed 1 on the root) and its native child — recorded as a documented divergence, not equalized
parameters.cache_policy: provider cache tokens reported separately and included only once in input

evaluation.semantic_uncertainty: manual independent review and recorded arbitration; never automatic semantic success

statistics.method: Paired, dependency-aware bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 174) over the pre-registered independent units — in series R the 5 question families (4 repetitions each), in series T the learning sequences — of the cumulative tokens per correct Tour per agent. The 95% confidence interval of the relative reduction must be strictly positive on EACH series; leave-one-family-out re-computation and the cumulative-denominator including failed runs form the sensitivity plan. Fewer than 5 independent information units, an unmatched comparison, or any missing usage forbids a global reduction and yields INDÉTERMINÉ.
statistics.independent_unit: question family or independent learning sequence, never repeated run by default

extension.reason: Additional question families and stopping rules have not been preregistered.

execution.freeze: only after successful external pilot and G0-G4 evidence; before first measured run
execution.agent_failures: preserve all partial usage and count in request denominator

diagnostic.ordered_pairs: CodeTour first for odd family indices; Vibe first for even family indices.
diagnostic.memory: Fresh R memory at start; retained across all five CodeTour requests.
